domain.description: Public domain name resolving to this host. Used by Caddy for automatic TLS on the admin UI.

admin_password.description: Password for the Pi-hole admin web UI.

dns_allowed_cidrs.description: Source CIDRs allowed to query DNS on port 53. Pi-hole MUST NOT be exposed as an open resolver.

upstream_dns.description: Upstream DNS resolvers Pi-hole forwards to. Defaults to Cloudflare and Quad9 if omitted.
